description: `prose delete job JOB_ID` puts the command word first: `prose cli job delete JOB_ID`.

problem.action: Use `cli job delete`: `prose --output json cli job delete 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10`.

details.reason: `delete job` is not a command; did you mean `prose --output json cli job delete 3c1a9e57-0b4d-4f2a-9e61-5d7b2c8a4f10`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
